## Hook Trigger Lifecycle

The complete flow from event trigger through action to continuation:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Event Triggered<br/>(User input, Tool use, Agent done)"] --> B["Hook Triggered"]
    B --> C["Condition Check"]
    C -->|Condition Met| D["Execute Action"]
    C -->|Condition Not Met| E["Skip Hook"]
    D --> F{Allow or Block?}
    F -->|Allow| G["Continue Normal Flow"]
    F -->|Block| H["Stop + Report Error"]
    E --> G

    style A fill:#bbdefb
    style B fill:#fff9c4
    style D fill:#c8e6c9
    style G fill:#a5d6a7
    style H fill:#ffccbc
```

---

## Session-Wide Hook Lifecycle

Complete hook execution order during a Claude Code session:

```mermaid
graph TD
    S["Session Starts"] --> H1["SessionStart Hook<br/>Initialize context"]
    H1 --> U["User Prompt"]
    U --> H2["UserPromptSubmit Hook<br/>Validate input"]
    H2 --> T["Tool Execution"]
    T --> H3["PreToolUse Hook<br/>Validate before"]
    H3 --> TE["Tool Executes"]
    TE --> H4["PostToolUse Hook<br/>Audit after"]
    H4 --> A["Agent Runs"]
    A --> H5["SubagentStop Hook<br/>Aggregate results"]
    H5 --> E["Session Ends"]
    E --> H6["SessionEnd Hook<br/>Cleanup/Report"]

    style H1 fill:#e1f5ff
    style H2 fill:#f3e5f5
    style H3 fill:#fff3e0
    style H4 fill:#f3e5f5
    style H5 fill:#e8f5e9
    style H6 fill:#ede7f6
```

## PreToolUse Hook - Validation Gate

Hook that prevents tool execution if conditions fail:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Claude
    participant Hook as PreToolUse Hook
    participant Tool

    User->>Claude: Execute tool (deploy)
    Claude->>Hook: Trigger PreToolUse
    Hook->>Hook: Check conditions<br/>(coverage, security, approval)
    alt Conditions Pass
        Hook->>Claude: ALLOW
        Claude->>Tool: Execute
        Tool-->>User: Success
    else Conditions Fail
        Hook->>Claude: BLOCK + Error message
        Claude-->>User: ❌ Cannot proceed<br/>Fix issue and retry
    end
```

---

## PostToolUse Hook - Audit Trail

Hook that logs and monitors after tool execution:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Tool
    participant Hook as PostToolUse Hook
    participant Logger as Audit Log
    participant Monitor as Health Check

    Tool->>Hook: Tool execution complete
    Hook->>Hook: Extract metrics<br/>(cost, result, time)
    par Logging
        Hook->>Logger: Write audit entry<br/>(timestamp, tool, args, user, result)
    and Monitoring
        Hook->>Monitor: Run health checks<br/>(API health, memory, errors)
    end
    alt Health Checks Pass
        Monitor-->>Tool: ✅ OK
    else Health Checks Fail
        Monitor->>Hook: Trigger action<br/>(rollback, alert)
    end
```

## Hook State Machine

Different states a hook can be in during execution:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle: Session starts
    Idle --> Triggered: Event fires
    Triggered --> Evaluating: Evaluate condition
    Evaluating --> Executing: Condition met
    Evaluating --> Skipped: Condition not met
    Executing --> Allowed: Action succeeds
    Executing --> Blocked: Action fails
    Allowed --> [*]: Continue normal flow
    Blocked --> [*]: Stop execution + Error
    Skipped --> [*]: Continue normal flow

    style Idle fill:#e1f5ff
    style Triggered fill:#fff9c4
    style Executing fill:#c8e6c9
    style Allowed fill:#a5d6a7
    style Blocked fill:#ffccbc
```

## Hook vs Command vs Agent - Decision Tree

When to use which automation mechanism:

```mermaid
graph TD
    Q1{"Is automation<br/>automatic?"}
    Q2{"Repeats every<br/>time?"}
    Q3{"Complex<br/>workflow?"}

    Q1 -->|No| Q4
    Q1 -->|Yes| Q2
    Q2 -->|No| Q4
    Q2 -->|Yes| Q3
    Q3 -->|No| HOOK["⚙️ Use HOOK<br/>Validation/Logging"]
    Q3 -->|Yes| AGENT["🤖 Use AGENT<br/>Complex orchestration"]
    Q4 -->|Yes| CMD["📋 Use COMMAND<br/>User shortcut"]

    style HOOK fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#4caf50,stroke-width:3px
```

## Validation Chain Pattern

Multiple hooks running in sequence for comprehensive validation:

```mermaid
graph TD
    U["User: npm run deploy"] --> H1["PreToolUse Hook #1<br/>Quality Gate"]
    H1 --> T1{Coverage<br/>Check}
    T1 -->|✅ Pass| H2["PreToolUse Hook #2<br/>Security Scan"]
    T1 -->|❌ Fail| E1["BLOCK + Report error<br/>Coverage too low"]
    H2 --> T2{Security<br/>Check}
    T2 -->|✅ Pass| H3["PreToolUse Hook #3<br/>Approval"]
    T2 -->|❌ Fail| E2["BLOCK + Report error<br/>Vulnerabilities found"]
    H3 --> T3{Approved<br/>by SOC?}
    T3 -->|✅ Yes| TOOL["✅ Tool Executes<br/>npm run deploy"]
    T3 -->|❌ No| E3["BLOCK + Report error<br/>Approval required"]

    style H1 fill:#fff3e0
    style H2 fill:#fff3e0
    style H3 fill:#fff3e0
    style TOOL fill:#c8e6c9
    style E1 fill:#ffccbc
    style E2 fill:#ffccbc
    style E3 fill:#ffccbc
```

## Auto-Rollback Pattern

PostToolUse hook monitoring deployment health:

```mermaid
graph TD
    D["Deploy to Production"] --> W["Wait 60 seconds<br/>for stabilization"]
    W --> H["PostToolUse Hook:<br/>Health Monitor"]
    H --> HC1["Check API<br/>response <500ms"]
    H --> HC2["Check error<br/>rate <1%"]
    H --> HC3["Check memory<br/>usage <80%"]
    HC1 --> T1{All checks<br/>pass?}
    HC2 --> T1
    HC3 --> T1
    T1 -->|✅ Yes| S["✅ Deployment Healthy<br/>Keep running"]
    T1 -->|❌ No| R["⚠️ Health Check Failed"]
    R --> RB["Execute Rollback<br/>restore-previous.sh"]
    RB --> A["Alert DevOps Team"]
    A --> F["❌ Rollback Complete"]

    style D fill:#bbdefb
    style S fill:#c8e6c9
    style F fill:#ffccbc
    style H fill:#fff3e0
```

## Cost Tracking Timeline

PostToolUse hook tracking costs across session:

```mermaid
timeline
    title Session Cost Tracking (PostToolUse Hook)
    section Session Start
        Budget: $100
    section Tool Uses
        Context7 Call 1: $5 cost → Total: $5
        Perplexity Query: $3 cost → Total: $8
        Context7 Call 2: $7 cost → Total: $15
    section Mid-Session
        Budget Check: Total: $15, Remaining: $85
    section More Tools
        Firecrawl Crawl: $8 cost → Total: $23
        Context7 Call 3: $4 cost → Total: $27
    section Alert Zone
        Approaching limit: Total: $45 (45% of $100)
    section Session End
        Final Cost: $65, Budget: $100
        Remaining: $35 Available
```

## SubagentStop - Progress Aggregation

Tracking multiple agents completing in parallel:

```mermaid
graph TD
    START["Translation Task<br/>15 languages"] --> A1["Agent-ES"]
    START --> A2["Agent-FR"]
    START --> A3["Agent-DE"]
    START --> A4["..."]
    START --> A15["Agent-ZH"]

    A1 --> H1["SubagentStop Hook<br/>Progress: 1/15"]
    A2 --> H2["SubagentStop Hook<br/>Progress: 2/15"]
    A3 --> H3["SubagentStop Hook<br/>Progress: 3/15"]
    A15 --> H15["SubagentStop Hook<br/>Progress: 15/15"]

    H1 --> STORE["Store in<br/>Session Context"]
    H2 --> STORE
    H3 --> STORE
    H15 --> STORE

    STORE --> CHECK{All agents<br/>complete?}
    CHECK -->|No| WAIT["Wait for next"]
    CHECK -->|Yes| AGG["Aggregate:<br/>14 success, 1 failure"]
    AGG --> REPORT["Report final<br/>summary to command"]

    style START fill:#bbdefb
    style H1 fill:#fff3e0
    style H2 fill:#fff3e0
    style H15 fill:#fff3e0
    style AGG fill:#c8e6c9
    style REPORT fill:#a5d6a7
```

## Hook Timing vs Command Timing

When hooks fire vs when commands run:

```mermaid
timeline
    title Timeline: Hook Events vs Command Execution
    section Session
        SessionStart Hook: Initialize context
        Load memory and config
    section User Interaction
        User types prompt: Waiting
        UserPromptSubmit Hook: Validate input
    section Tool Execution
        PreToolUse Hook: Check before
        /deploy Command: Optional user command
        Bash Tool: Execute
        PostToolUse Hook: Log after
    section Agent Completion
        SubagentStop Hook: Aggregate each agent
        /summary Command: Optional user command
    section End
        SessionEnd Hook: Final cleanup
        Generate report
```

## Error Handling in Hooks

Hook error flows and fallback strategies:

```mermaid
graph TD
    HOOK["Hook Triggered"] --> TRY["Try to execute"]
    TRY --> CHECK{Condition<br/>check?}
    CHECK -->|Pass| ACT["Execute action"]
    CHECK -->|Fail| ERR1["❌ Condition failed"]
    ACT --> ERR_CHECK{Action<br/>success?}
    ERR_CHECK -->|Yes| ALLOW["✅ Allow/Log"]
    ERR_CHECK -->|No| ERR2["❌ Action failed"]
    ERR1 --> FALLBACK["Use fallback strategy"]
    ERR2 --> FALLBACK
    FALLBACK --> DECIDE{Critical<br/>action?}
    DECIDE -->|Yes| BLOCK["BLOCK execution<br/>Report error"]
    DECIDE -->|No| ALLOW
    ALLOW --> DONE["Hook complete"]
    BLOCK --> DONE

    style ERR1 fill:#ffccbc
    style ERR2 fill:#ffccbc
    style BLOCK fill:#ffccbc
    style ALLOW fill:#c8e6c9
```

## Real-World Example: CI/CD Pipeline Flow

Complete deployment workflow with hooks at each stage:

```mermaid
graph TD
    START["Developer: git push"] --> TEST["Run tests"]
    TEST --> H1["PreToolUse Hook:<br/>Quality Gate<br/>Check coverage >80%"]
    H1 --> COVERAGE{Coverage<br/>OK?}
    COVERAGE -->|❌ No| FAIL1["BLOCK<br/>Run: npm test:coverage"]
    COVERAGE -->|✅ Yes| BUILD["Build application"]
    BUILD --> H2["PreToolUse Hook:<br/>Security Scan<br/>Check vuln"]
    H2 --> SECURITY{Secure?}
    SECURITY -->|❌ No| FAIL2["BLOCK<br/>Fix vulnerabilities"]
    SECURITY -->|✅ Yes| DEPLOY["Deploy to prod"]
    DEPLOY --> H3["PostToolUse Hook:<br/>Auto-Rollback<br/>Monitor health 60s"]
    H3 --> HEALTH{Health<br/>checks OK?}
    HEALTH -->|❌ No| ROLLBACK["ROLLBACK<br/>Restore previous"]
    HEALTH -->|✅ Yes| H4["PostToolUse Hook:<br/>Audit Log<br/>Log to audit trail"]
    H4 --> DONE["✅ Deployment complete"]

    style H1 fill:#fff3e0
    style H2 fill:#fff3e0
    style H3 fill:#fff3e0
    style H4 fill:#fff3e0
    style DONE fill:#c8e6c9
    style FAIL1 fill:#ffccbc
    style FAIL2 fill:#ffccbc
    style ROLLBACK fill:#ffccbc
```

```mermaid
graph TD
    START["Start<br/>New Automation"] --> LINES["Count logic<br/>lines needed"]
    LINES --> L1{"<20<br/>lines?"}
```
